legend.type: BAU = business-as-usual (expected variation); BLACK-SWAN = rare, high-impact event or structural shock
legend.likelihood: Qualitative Low / Medium / High. Where an official probability exists it is quoted with its source.
legend.impact: Direction of impact on property value or personal wealth if the risk realizes
legend.affects: Which decision strategy the risk changes most: HOLD (renew/extend), SELL (outright sale before expiry), EXCHANGE (sell into an IRC 1031 exchange), ALL

risks.risk: Tenant same-store sales keep declining
risks.impact: Negative: weaker renewal economics, lower rent capacity, lower exit multiple
risks.evidence: Q3 FY2026 system SSS -1.1%; 40-week SSS -4.2%; FY2026 guidance a low-single-digit decline
risks.mitigation: Negotiate renewal early with CPI-linked escalators; set a sale trigger on a second consecutive year of decline

risks.risk: Tenant system keeps shrinking (elevated closures)
risks.impact: Negative: elevated vacancy and re-tenanting risk at or before the 2030-2035 expiry
risks.evidence: Q3 FY2026: 4 openings vs 17 closures; FY2026 guidance about 50-60 closures against roughly 25 openings; count guided to about 2,100
risks.mitigation: Confirm assignment and sublease rights; size a re-tenanting reserve; prefer selling before expiry if renewal terms are weak

risks.risk: Franchisee financial stress flows through to landlord
risks.impact: Negative: arrears, default, or forced surrender of the site
risks.evidence: Franchise-level margin fell to $60.3M (37.4%) from $66.2M (39.3%); higher bad debt expense; restaurant-level margin 17.6% vs 17.9%
risks.mitigation: Obtain tenant financials in renewal negotiation; require guaranty or escrow where negotiable

risks.risk: Cap-rate expansion compresses the sale price
risks.impact: Negative: lower gross proceeds for the same NOI
risks.evidence: 10-year Treasury at 4.98% on 2026-11-10, up from 4.84% five days earlier; 30-year at 5.35%
risks.mitigation: Set a disciplined reserve price; stage the sale process; use the model's breakeven cap grid rather than a single point forecast

risks.risk: Further Federal Reserve tightening
risks.impact: Negative: higher financing costs for buyers, cap-rate pressure
risks.evidence: Target range raised to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 and held on 2026-10-28 by a 10-2 vote with two dissents favoring another hike
risks.mitigation: Underwrite offers against a rate-sensitivity grid; prefer all-cash or pre-approved buyers

risks.risk: Measure ULA transfer tax if the parcel sits in City limits
risks.impact: Negative: 4.45% all-in on tier-1 consideration (5.95% tier 2), payable by the seller
risks.evidence: Office of Finance: thresholds $5.4M / $10.9M after 2026-06-30; combined 4.45% / 5.95% with the base rate
risks.mitigation: Resolve jurisdiction first (F-N1); if in City, price the tax into every offer comparison and model the below-threshold pricing cliff

risks.risk: ULA remains in force after litigation
risks.impact: Neutral-to-negative: no repeal is pending after the appeal was lost
risks.evidence: Court of Appeal No. B334071 (2025-12-15) affirmed dismissal; Measure ULA upheld as a valid exercise of initiative power
risks.mitigation: Plan around ULA rather than awaiting repeal; monitor any further review separately

risks.risk: County population decline persists
risks.impact: Negative: structurally weaker demand for restaurant real estate and housing at the margin
risks.evidence: DOF: county -0.6% in 2025 (about -64,000 persons) attributed to the fires, Inland Empire outflow and deportations; city -0.9%
risks.mitigation: Weight renewal terms and exit pricing to submarket evidence, not metro averages

risks.risk: School enrollment decline continues
risks.impact: Negative: long-run household formation and neighborhood retail demand headwind
risks.evidence: DOF 2026 Series: LA County K-12 down 240,800 students by 2035-36; statewide ninth consecutive annual decrease
risks.mitigation: Treat as a structural discount to any hold thesis beyond the current lease term

risks.risk: Labor-cost escalation at the restaurant
risks.impact: Negative for tenant margins; indirect pressure on rent capacity
risks.evidence: City of LA minimum wage $18.42/hr from 2026-07-01 (+3.08%); California fast-food wage $20.00/hr; metro ECI +3.9% YoY
risks.mitigation: Favor NNN structure with full expense pass-through; monitor tenant margin disclosures

risks.risk: Inflation re-acceleration raises renewals and opex
risks.impact: Mixed: helps CPI-linked rents, hurts buyer yields
risks.evidence: CPI-U LA metro +3.7% YoY (Sep-26); energy +20.3%
risks.mitigation: Insist on CPI-linked escalators with a floor in any renewal

risks.risk: Re-tenanting cost and downtime if the tenant vacates at expiry
risks.impact: Negative: 6-18 months of lost NOI plus leasing capital
risks.evidence: System closures running well above openings; the company runs a block-closure program
risks.mitigation: Pre-market the site before expiry; keep a re-tenanting reserve in the hold case

risks.risk: Liquidity gap above the ULA threshold
risks.impact: Negative: fewer buyers transact near the $5.4M cliff
risks.evidence: Proposition 43, which would have raised approval thresholds for future voter-sponsored local special taxes, is failing (57.4% No) - the ULA mechanism itself is not weakened
risks.mitigation: Run both price scenarios (below and above threshold) in any offer comparison

risks.risk: Property tax reassessment on sale raises buyer's carry
risks.impact: Negative for buyer bids: Prop 13 base resets to purchase price plus voter-approved debt
risks.evidence: Assessor: reassessment to market value on change of ownership; base levy 1% plus voter-approved debt
risks.mitigation: Quantify the buyer's after-tax carry in the offering materials

risks.risk: Capital-gains tax on an outright sale
risks.impact: Negative: up to 13.30% CA top marginal plus federal rates on the gain; basis is private (F-N1)
risks.evidence: CA top regular rate 12.30% plus 1% MHST (M83-M85); Proposition 3 (2026) makes the underlying high-income rates permanent
risks.mitigation: Compare after-tax sale proceeds against a 1031 exchange case; obtain basis from tax records

risks.risk: 1031 exchange execution failure
risks.impact: Negative: gain recognition if deadlines are missed
risks.evidence: IRS: identify replacement within 45 days; receive within 180 days or the return due date, whichever is earlier; QI required for safe harbor
risks.mitigation: Engage a qualified intermediary before listing; pre-identify replacement inventory

risks.risk: Insurance cost or non-renewal at renewal dates
risks.impact: Negative: NNN pass-through still hits tenant margins; non-renewal can impair value
risks.evidence: CDI: $23.87B paid across the Palisades and Eaton fires as of March 2026 (M107)
risks.mitigation: Obtain a current insurance quote and loss-run before deciding; verify NNN insurance clause

risks.risk: Trade and logistics softness in the port economy
risks.impact: Negative: regional employment and consumer-spending sensitivity
risks.evidence: 2025 port throughput 10.2M TEUs - third-best year, but October YTD volume only +2% and loaded exports down in 2025
risks.mitigation: Track monthly port releases as a leading indicator for submarket retail demand

risks.risk: Forecast error in regional projections
risks.impact: Mixed: decisions built on stale forecasts misprice risk
risks.evidence: LAEDC (Feb-2026) forecast county unemployment of 5.9% for 2026; the actual SA print for Sep-2026 is 4.8%
risks.mitigation: Refresh forecasts each quarter; weight current official data over older projections

risks.risk: Major earthquake (M6.7+ ) in the Los Angeles region
risks.impact: Severe: structural damage, casualty loss, extended downtime, insurance disputes
risks.evidence: USGS UCERF3: 60% M6.7, 46% M7.0, 31% M7.5 within 30 years
risks.mitigation: Verify seismic coverage and retrofit status before any hold decision; earthquake damage is not covered by standard property policies

risks.risk: Wildfire with urban interface impact (Eaton-class)
risks.likelihood: Low-to-Medium for a Central LA parcel; regional hazard is active
risks.impact: Severe: the January 2025 fires destroyed 9,418 structures in one incident
risks.evidence: CAL FIRE: Eaton Fire 14,021 acres, 9,418 destroyed, 1,073 damaged
risks.mitigation: Obtain the parcel's FHSZ class (F-N3); confirm defensible-space compliance and carrier appetite

risks.risk: Insurance market retreat after a major event
risks.impact: Severe: premium spikes or non-renewal compress value and tenant economics
risks.evidence: CDI published $23.87B in paid claims across the two January 2025 fires as of March 2026
risks.mitigation: Bind multi-year coverage where available; stress-test NNN pass-through limits

risks.risk: Tenant brand or franchise-system distress (closure wave beyond guidance)
risks.impact: Severe: single-tenant asset loses its income source before expiry
risks.evidence: FY2026 guidance already contemplates 50-60 closures; dividend and buyback discontinued; leverage reduced to about 6.3x via refinancing
risks.mitigation: Diversify via sale or 1031 into multi-tenant or multi-property income; monitor 10-Qs quarterly

risks.risk: Recession sharply curbing consumer spending
risks.impact: Severe: traffic and sales decline across the restaurant system
risks.evidence: FOMC (2026-10-28): activity expanding at a strong pace with inflation elevated - current conditions are not recessionary, but policy is restrictive
risks.mitigation: Prefer NNN with corporate or strong-franchisee credit; maintain liquidity for a sale window

risks.risk: Immigration-enforcement shock to population and labor
risks.impact: Negative: population loss and labor scarcity already visible in official data
risks.evidence: DOF attributes part of the county's -64,000 2025 decline to deportations; net legal international migration to California more than halved to 126,400
risks.mitigation: Model demand on county and subpopulation trends, not metro growth assumptions

risks.risk: Tariff or trade-policy shock to the logistics economy
risks.impact: Negative: port volumes and warehouse employment swing quickly
risks.evidence: Port volumes were volatile through 2025 with shippers pulling cargo ahead of tariff deadlines
risks.mitigation: Watch monthly port data; treat trade policy as an active scenario, not a footnote

risks.risk: Civil unrest or service disruption in the urban core
risks.impact: Temporary damage, closure days, security costs
risks.evidence: No official dataset quantifies this risk for the parcel; qualitative only
risks.mitigation: Insurance verification; operational continuity plan with the tenant

risks.risk: Interest-rate spike re-pricing all commercial real estate
risks.impact: Severe: bid-ask spreads widen, sales stall, refinancing costs jump
risks.evidence: 10-year moved between 4.84% and 4.98% within five sessions in November 2026; 30-year at 5.35%
risks.mitigation: Lock a buyer's rate assumption in writing; consider installment or seller-carry structures only with counsel
